title: Genius contains us

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Expose a useful meaning inside a familiar word because a visual discovery can make a short message memorable.
strategic_value: Pulling US out of GENIUS can give Figma’s collective-creativity argument a compact verbal signature.
demonstration: Cursors manipulate the letters of GENIUS, select US and lift that pair away from the remaining letters.
practical_value: Use letter-level motion when the structure of a word supports the campaign idea.

content_islands.name: Whole word
content_islands.spec: Begin with black GENIUS centered on white.

content_islands.name: Letter manipulation
content_islands.spec: Show multiple cursors and blue selection handles moving the I and then selecting US.

content_islands.name: Collective emphasis
content_islands.spec: Lift US above the remaining GENI letters.

reference_purposes.Expression: Selection-box animation isolates US inside GENIUS.
reference_purposes.Intent: The surrounding case-study narrative explains the campaign’s rejection of the solitary-genius myth.
